addresses.text: Tower B, Tech Innovation Park, Sector 62

menu.name: Royal Dum Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
menu.description: Authentic long-grain basmati cooked with tender chicken marinated in 21 secret spices and slow-cooked in sealed clay handi with saffron.

menu.name: Nawabi Paneer Dum Biryani
menu.description: Fragrant saffron basmati rice layered with melt-in-mouth cottage cheese chunks, caramelized onions, and fresh mint leaves.

menu.name: Awadhi Dum Mutton Biryani (Special)
menu.description: Prime cuts of tender mutton slow-braised in aromatic whole spices, layered with royal saffron rice and drizzled with desi ghee.

menu.name: Lucknowi Murgh Dum Biryani
menu.description: Subtle and aromatic white-gravy style royal biryani cooked with bone-in chicken thighs, rose water, and kewra essence.

menu.name: Kolkata Special Egg Biryani (2 Eggs)
menu.description: Classic Kolkata style biryani with golden pan-fried eggs, spiced large potato chunk, and mildly sweet cardamom infused rice.

menu.name: Saffron Subz Handi Biryani
menu.description: Fresh farm carrots, beans, florets, and green peas layered with kewra saffron basmati and golden fried shallots.

menu.name: Galouti Kebab with Roomali Roti (4 pcs)
menu.description: Silky, aromatic Lucknowi minced meat patties pan-seared in pure ghee, served with mint chutney and pickled onions.

menu.name: Shahi Tukda with Rabri
menu.description: Crisp golden brioche soaked in cardamom syrup and blanketed with thickened saffron rabri and sliced pistachios.

menu.name: Chilled Masala Chaas Cooler
menu.description: Traditional buttermilk blended with roasted cumin, mint, green chillies, and rock salt for perfect digestion.

menu.name: Classic Margherita Di Bufala (12")
menu.description: San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh buffalo mozzarella, hand-torn sweet basil, and extra virgin olive oil on 48h cold fermented crust.

menu.name: Fiery Pepperoni & Hot Honey Pizza (12")
menu.description: Crispy pork pepperoni cups, shredded whole-milk mozzarella, house marinara, finished with chilli-infused hot honey drizzle.

menu.name: Farmhouse Veggie Supreme Pizza (12")
menu.description: Crunchy bell peppers, black olives, sweet corn, button mushrooms, red onions, and melted mozzarella over herb tomato base.

menu.name: Quattro Formaggi 4-Cheese Pizza (12")
menu.description: Decadent white pizza with smoked gorgonzola, aged parmesan, fresh mozzarella, and creamy fontina cheese.

menu.name: Peri-Peri Smoked Chicken Pizza (12")
menu.description: Smokey shredded roast chicken, spicy peri-peri drizzle, red paprika, and gooey cheese on crispy hand-stretched sourdough.

menu.name: Paneer Tikka Makhani Pizza (12")
menu.description: Tandoori spiced paneer cubes, capsicum, pickled onion rings with rich buttery makhani sauce and fresh coriander.

menu.name: Truffle Parmesan Garlic Breadsticks
menu.description: Pull-apart brioche breadsticks glazed with black truffle butter, aged parmesan, and roasted garlic aioli dip.

menu.name: Double Chocolate Fudge Brownie
menu.description: Warm Belgian dark chocolate brownie loaded with molten chips, served with chocolate ganache.

menu.name: Italian Peach Sparkler Iced Tea
menu.description: Brewed black tea infused with natural Italian white peach puree, mint, and crushed ice.

menu.name: The Smokey BBQ Bacon Cheeseburger
menu.description: Smashed juicy patty, sharp cheddar, crispy smoked bacon, caramelized onion jam, and smokey chipotle mayo in toasted brioche.

menu.name: Crispy Truffle Mushroom Crunch Burger
menu.description: Golden panko-crusted portobello mushroom stuffed with molten cheese, truffle garlic sauce, fresh arugula, and pickles.

menu.description: Extra crunchy fried chicken breast fillet coated in hot spices, thousand island glaze, crispy iceberg lettuce in sesame bun.

menu.name: Peri-Peri Paneer Crunch Burger
menu.description: Thick marinated cottage cheese steak flash-fried to golden crispness, tossed in African peri-peri seasoning and creamy garlic mayo.

menu.name: Spicy Mexican Jalapeño Nacho Burger
menu.description: Spiced black bean and sweet corn patty, crunchy tortilla nachos, pickled jalapeño slices, salsa roja, and molten cheese.

menu.name: Ultimate Double Decker Crispy Patty Burger
menu.description: Two gigantic crispy chicken patties stacked with double melted American cheddar, gherkins, and house special secret burger sauce.

menu.name: Peri-Peri Loaded Cheese Fries
menu.description: Skin-on crispy fries tossed in fiery African peri-peri dust, topped with warm liquid cheese sauce and jalapeños.

menu.name: Crispy Golden Onion Rings with Garlic Dip
menu.description: Thick hand-cut Spanish onion rings coated in seasoned batter and panko crumbs, served with garlic herb aioli.

menu.name: Salted Caramel Hazelnut Thickshake
menu.description: Rich vanilla ice cream blended with roasted crushed hazelnuts, English toffee caramel, and sea salt flakes.

menu.name: Oreo Overload Monster Shake
menu.description: Creamy cookies and cream shake with blended Oreo crumbles, chocolate drizzle, and whipped cream crown.

restaurants.name: Wok & Roll Asian Street
restaurants.address: East Wing, Metro Junction Food Court

menu.name: Spicy Hakka Noodles with Chilli Paneer Bowl
menu.description: Wok-tossed noodles with bell peppers, spring onions, paired with wok-glazed crispy cottage cheese in spicy garlic sauce.

menu.name: Steamed Crystal Chicken Dimsums (6 pcs)
menu.description: Translucent tapioca dumplings filled with minced chicken, ginger, and lemongrass, served with burnt garlic chilli oil.

menu.name: Schezwan Chicken Fried Rice Bowl
menu.description: Fragrant basmati wok-tossed in artisanal fiery Schezwan paste with diced tender chicken, scrambled eggs, and spring onion greens.

menu.name: Crispy Veg Spring Rolls (4 pcs)
menu.description: Golden fried paper-thin rolls packed with glass noodles, cabbage, and carrots with sweet Thai chilli dip.

menu.description: Long grain rice tossed with golden fried minced garlic, assorted diced veggies, and oriental sesame oil.

menu.name: Teriyaki Glazed Chicken Bao Buns (2 pcs)
menu.description: Pillow-soft steamed lotus leaf bao buns stuffed with sweet and savory teriyaki grilled chicken, pickled cucumber, and sriracha mayo.

menu.description: Refreshing tropical lychee nectar infused with bruised lemongrass stalks, lemon juice, and sparkling soda.

menu.description: Tri-color quinoa, ripe Hass avocado, kalamata olives, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, feta crumble, and lemon oregano vinaigrette.

menu.name: Berry Blast Acai Protein Smoothie Bowl
menu.description: Organic acai blended with almond milk, topped with chia seeds, fresh blueberries, banana slices, and toasted coconut flakes.

menu.description: Rosemary grilled chicken breast, crisp romaine lettuce, sourdough croutons, shaved parmesan, and light Greek yogurt caesar dressing.

menu.description: Crumbled Greek feta, roasted zucchini, bell peppers, baby spinach, toasted pumpkin seeds, and cold pressed olive oil dressing.

menu.description: Spiced cottage cheese cubes, Japanese edamame beans, brown basmati, purple cabbage slaw, and toasted sesame tahini drizzle.

menu.description: Golden chickpea falafel patties, velvety garlic hummus, pickled cucumbers, tomato relish, and tahini sauce in warm pita.
